description: /orrery - deep-dives any codebase with parallel read-only scout agents and generates an interactive, zoomable, embeddable system-design map as one self-contained HTML file: 4 zoom tiers (landscape to key files), file-level GitHub links pinned to an anchor SHA, external systems, and per-node product-context prose. /orrery update refreshes incrementally. Under construction: this release ships the scaffold - the lockfile-pinned LikeC4 render/validate toolchain, the fragment/model JSON contracts, the restricted orrery-scout agent, and deterministic fixtures; the full build flow lands in later epics.
name: orrery
